title: Q-SEED-what-works: seed what-works is deployed; take it to live (SEED-LIFECYCLE-1)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** every watchdog pass (seedlife --run)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation seedlife --probe what-works
**Status:** open

SEED-LIFECYCLE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-21): a seed is built, deployed, verified live and wired into its loops, with a design goal of 365 days unattended. A plan is not a system.

Stage: deployed. Next: live.

What the next stages need, computed from evidence:
- live: a passing verify of https://what-works.ultrastable.org/health expecting '"ok":true' inside 48 h

Gates it runs on (identity-bound, default in effect): payment.

Answers live in instances/what-works/lifecycle.json; build the code under the paths it names, deploy through the lane (doctrine/topology.json), and close each open survival class with a probe. Never edit the claim or this item to pass.

size: L

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation seedlife --probe what-works` exits 0.
